rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: No completed felling overlaps the 4.29 ha polygon (0%).

One eligible species lies beyond 250 m but within 1000 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (VU lichen, forest-associated, site-bound; threats include lack of continuity forest and of large/old trees). Four records, nearest 632 m, 2025, uncertainty 50 m. None is within 250 m. The rubric hint is MEDIUM.

Near-site recording is thin: one record within 250 m (a mobile NT bird, Pernis apivorus, 2016, uncertainty 200 m) and none inside the polygon. Effort within 1000 m is low (16 records, 20th percentile of the county sample), and threatened species are recorded within 1000 m. This is an unresolved contradiction.
Mobile birds are listed within 250 m (Aegolius funereus EN 149 m, 2022, uncertainty 500 m; Pernis apivorus NT). They are supporting evidence only and are not eligible species.

uncertainties: The eligible lichen records are at least 632 m away; whether similar habitat extends into the polygon is unknown.
Low recording effort means the lack of eligible records within 250 m is weakly informative.
The bird records have coarse coordinates (200-500 m) relative to the site's 117 m equivalent radius, and the 250 m query dropped one coarse record.
not_established: That any red-listed species occurs on the polygon.
That absence of records within 250 m means absence of species.
Legal protection, or the legality or ecological effect of the felling.
next_action: Human reviewer should consider a field check, since few people have recorded here, and compare the polygon's stand with the area of the 2025 Alectoria sarmentosa records at 632-831 m.
